items.title: Stocks mixed as oil prices pause climb but yields hover near highs
items.summary: Global bond yields remain near multi-decade highs as inflation worries persist. Stock markets found scattered relief as oil prices pulled back on Friday. U.S. Treasury yields stayed near their highest levels since 2007 and 2011. Investors anticipate potential interest rate hikes from central banks globally. Major currencies were steady against the dollar, while the yen weakened significantly.

items.title: Rupee hits day’s low against US dollar, recovers on RBI support
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's interventions prevented the rupee from falling to a new record low.  State-run banks sold dollars, and foreign investor inflows aided the currency's recovery.  High oil prices and importer demand put pressure on the rupee throughout the day.  Brent crude prices retreated after topping one hundred dollars a barrel.  The rupee closed little changed, recovering from its intraday low.

items.title: BNP Paribas Cardif to acquire Warburg’s 26% in IndiaFirst Life
items.summary: BNP Paribas Cardif will re-enter India's life insurance market soon.  The French insurer is acquiring Warburg Pincus' stake in IndiaFirst Life.  This transaction values the Bank of Baroda-controlled insurer at approximately ten thousand crore rupees.  Bank of Baroda will retain its controlling interest and management control.  BNP Paribas Cardif will hold twenty-six percent of the insurer's shares.

items.title: Nifty closes below key 23,800 level on Gulf war ripples
items.summary: Indian equities experienced a decline on Friday, influenced by rising crude oil prices. The depreciation of the Indian rupee also contributed to investor apprehension during the trading session. Major indices partially recovered from earlier lows, but the Nifty closed below a key support level. This closing position suggests a potential for further downward movement in the market.

items.title: Index entry wait may temper bond rally as FPI inflows start to ease
items.summary: Indian bond rally may slow as foreign investor flows decrease.  The benchmark government bond may trade in a tight range ahead.  Higher government borrowing and interest rate uncertainty limit investor enthusiasm.  Crude oil prices will remain a key factor dictating yield movements.  Treasury gains are expected to be under pressure for banks.

items.title: More banks may join overseas bond run after ICICI Bank’s bumper dollar bond sale
items.summary: ICICI Bank successfully raised one billion dollars through its inaugural dollar bond sale. This strong investor demand allowed the bank to double its initial offering size. The successful transaction signals confidence in Indian bank credit from global investors. Other lenders are now preparing to raise dollar bonds using a subsidized hedging facility. This initiative aims to lower borrowing costs and support capital inflows into India.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: US stocks face tests from Fed decision, tech-led earnings deluge
items.summary: Investors await the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision and corporate earnings reports.  Technology giants and artificial intelligence companies will release their quarterly results.  Rising oil prices and inflation concerns add complexity to the economic outlook.  The market remains sensitive to any signs of economic imperfection and policy shifts.  Future interest rate movements will significantly influence investor sentiment and stock valuations.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q1 Results: PAT falls 72% to Rs 1,278 crore, NII misses Street estimates—Key takeaways for investors
items.summary: PSU lender Bank of Baroda reported a worse-than-expected net interest income of Rs 12,525 crore for the April-June 2026 period.

items.title: Q1 results 2026: AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC First Bank, Zen Technologies, among companies to announce earnings today
items.summary: On July 25, around 25 companies, including AU Small Finance Bank and IDFC First Bank, will report Q1 FY27 earnings. Investors key in on outlook commentary as Indian stocks face pressure, following a five-session decline with geopolitical tensions and elevated crude oil prices.

items.summary: Sebi's proposed changes are expected to attract fresh allocations by existing investors and a new class of investors that may find the proposed products lucrative.

items.title: FMCG companies reap rewards from digital-first brand acquisitions as online bets drive growth
items.summary: Digital brands that have been acquired have quickly become the most rapidly expanding segments within major consumer companies. For FY26, these brands achieved a collective revenue of over ₹2,000 crore. Notably, Marico's digital division surpassed an impressive annual revenue run rate of ₹1,500 crore.

items.summary: Paramount agrees to delay closing Warner buyout for months while judge considers states' challenge

items.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq lags on angst over AI spending ahead of earnings reports
items.summary: U.S. markets closed mixed as the Nasdaq declined on chip stock weakness driven by concerns over heavy AI spending, while the Dow rose and the S&P 500 was nearly flat. Falling oil prices offered support, though geopolitical tensions and tariff developments kept investor sentiment cautious ahead of major tech earnings.

items.title: Index entry wait may temper bond rally
items.summary: The rally in Indian government bonds is expected to lose momentum as hopes of inclusion in Bloomberg's Global Aggregate Index fade and the yield gap with developed markets narrows, with traders expecting yields to remain range-bound amid higher borrowing, interest rate uncertainty and crude oil price volatility.

items.title: More banks may join overseas bond run
items.summary: ICICI Bank's $1 billion dollar bond sale via GIFT City, which drew strong global investor demand and secured lower borrowing costs, is expected to spur more Indian lenders to tap overseas debt markets under the RBI's subsidised hedging facility.

items.title: Dalmia Bharat sees new assets boosting volumes soon; Profit falls 50%
items.summary: Dalmia Bharat's newly acquired central India assets will contribute meaningfully to volumes starting this fiscal's third quarter. The company acquired cement assets from Adani Group, adding over five million tonnes of capacity. Operations have commenced at Chunar and trial production began at Rewa within fifty days. Consolidated profit halved in the June quarter due to higher costs and an exceptional loss.

items.title: Gen Z props up Delhi's hostel business as hotels miss corporate travellers amid internet shutdowns, traffic curbs
items.summary: The ongoing student protests in Delhi are disrupting travel and hospitality, with backpacker hostels reporting a surge in Gen Z bookings while hotels face weaker corporate demand due to internet shutdowns, traffic curbs, metro closures and work-from-home advisories.

items.title: Onida looks to monetise realty assets for revival
items.summary: Onida Electronics is monetising its real estate portfolio to raise crucial funds.  The company plans to revive its iconic television brand and compete effectively.  Three land parcels, including its Mumbai headquarters, are being evaluated for sale.  Operations at the Wada manufacturing facility have been discontinued and exited.  Television production will now be outsourced to contract manufacturers.

items.title: RJ Corp picks former Diageo maven Prathmesh Mishra to expand drinks play
items.summary: RJ Corp, led by Ravi Jaipuria, has appointed former Diageo executive Prathmesh Mishra as it explores expanding into the premium alcoholic beverages segment, according to people familiar with the matter. The move comes after PepsiCo bottler Varun Beverages signed a new agreement allowing it to diversify beyond soft drinks, amid strong growth in India's premium spirits market. Mishra brings extensive experience from Diageo, Pernod Ricard and Mohan Meakins, while RJ Corp is also evaluating opportunities in the beer segment, including a potential stake acquisition in Bira 91.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc bets big on silver biz to drive growth
items.summary: Silver will drive Hindustan Zinc's growth over the next five years.  Output is expected to double, significantly boosting earnings.  Zinc prices remain stable, while silver prices offer substantial upside potential.  Revenue and EBITDA from silver nearly tripled year-on-year in the June quarter.  A demerger is not an immediate priority due to operational complexities.

items.title: Import curbs for six months on suspension grade PVC resin
items.summary: The government has restricted imports of low-priced suspension-grade PVC resin for six months by introducing a minimum import price, while exempting export-oriented units and certain export-linked schemes. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade imposed the restriction following an anti-dumping investigation initiated after complaints from domestic manufacturers over alleged dumping of PVC resin from seven countries.

items.title: Office-focused REITs raise over $1 billion in April-June
items.summary: Office-focused funds and REITs raised over one billion dollars in the second quarter.  This fundraising was driven by investor appetite for income-generating commercial real estate.  Total fundraising saw a significant increase year-on-year and sequentially.  REITs are increasingly using corporate debt markets to optimize capital structures.  This diversification of capital contributes to a deeper and more resilient investment landscape.

items.title: No TV ratings agency registered under new policy yet; viewership data unlikely to resume soon, says govt
items.summary: Currently, television ratings agencies have yet to register under the enhanced government policy, which includes tough compliance measures such as appointing independent directors to BARC's board. The Kerala High Court has removed its stay on the landing-page provision, but it appears that the resumption of television viewership data will not occur anytime soon.

items.title: New 10% levy by US to place India's apparel exporters at disadvantage
items.summary: India's textile and apparel exporters may face competitive challenges in the US market after Washington imposed a 10% tariff citing concerns over forced labour in supply chains. The Confederation of Indian Textile Industry said the move could affect exports and create reputational risks. The industry body urged the Indian government to raise the issue with US authorities.

items.title: Adani shows interest to start airline in letter; denies plans in stock exchange filing
items.summary: Adani Airports seeks a waiver to operate an airline alongside its airport holdings. The conglomerate is evaluating airline participation to bridge connectivity gaps in smaller cities. This move aims to address systemic risks from a concentrated airline market. Existing airlines express concerns about potential conflicts of interest and consumer impact. The group's strategy aligns with plans for an aircraft manufacturing facility.

items.summary: Two former Volkswagen AG engineers were arrested for insider trading over bets they placed ahead of the German carmaker’s announcement of a $5 billion joint venture with electric-vehicle maker Rivian Automotive Inc.

items.title: Renewable energy expansion, battery storage push key to green transition: Pralhad Joshi
items.summary: India is accelerating its clean energy transition with a strong push in battery storage, wind and solar power, Union minister Pralhad Joshi said at the Sustainability Conclave 2026 in New Delhi. He highlighted that investments in energy storage and renewables are expected to reduce electricity costs, while initiatives like hydrogen-powered trains signal progress in next-generation technologies.

items.title: Warburg Pincus to sell 26% stake in IndiaFirst Life Insurance to BNP Paribas Cardif
items.summary: Following the transaction, BNP Paribas will become the second biggest shareholder in the company after Bank of Baroda, which holds 65% stake. Union Bank of India holds the remaining 9% share in the insurance company.

items.title: FM Sitharaman asks I-T Department to separate genuine errors from wilful tax evasion
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman called on the Income Tax Department to embrace a more taxpayer-friendly attitude. She highlighted the importance of differentiating between honest errors and deliberate tax fraud. Sitharaman encouraged officials to exercise their enforcement powers with a sense of humility and restraint, reminding them that their role now focuses on equity, especially with the upcoming Income Tax Act, 2025 aimed at simplifying regulations.

items.title: American Express shares tumble despite robust earnings, higher revenue outlook as rising costs weigh on sentiment
items.summary: Total card spending, or billed business, climbed 9% year over year to $455.8 billion on a foreign exchange-adjusted basis. Quarterly revenue also rose 10% to $19.6 billion, reflecting healthy consumer activity

items.title: Small-cap Orient Technologies shares to be in focus on Monday after  ₹76 crore NPCI order
items.summary: Orient Technologies is set to gain attention after receiving a  ₹76.2 crore order from NPCI for server supply, scheduled over 18 weeks. This contract strengthens its capabilities in enterprise infrastructure amid a volatile stock trend, down 37% in 2026 and struggling for momentum.

items.title: Bank of Baroda says recent NMC settlement based on commercial considerations, anticipation of legal overhang
items.summary: Bank of Baroda's $600 million settlement of the NMC Health litigation wiped out most of its Q1 profit, which fell 72% to  ₹1,207 crore. The bank held its FY27 credit growth guidance steady despite 17.4% loan growth and rising FCNR inflows.

items.title: India's exports to UK may reach USD 115 bn by 2030 due to trade pact: Assocham
items.summary: India's trade with Britain is projected to hit USD 115 billion by 2030, promising the creation of approximately 700,000 to 1 million jobs. To thrive in this evolving landscape, Indian businesses need to focus on competitiveness and quality assurance. Moreover, improving the ease of doing business and boosting infrastructure investments are critical for success, particularly in the engineering goods sector, which is poised for significant growth and innovative opportunities.

items.title: Refinery expansion plans will not be affected by temporary flare-up, confident of recouping losses: Bharat Petroleum
items.summary: Senior executives at BPCL expect oil prices to cool off after the latest flare-up which is expected to be temporary.

items.title: Eli Lilly-backed Scribe Therapeutics climbs 67% after raising $128.7 million in an upsized IPO
items.summary: Scribe Therapeutics, a developer of gene therapies for heart diseases, rose 67% after raising $128.7 million in its IPO.

items.title: Manipal Hospitals'  ₹9,275 crore IPO to strengthen balance sheet for growth
items.summary: Manipal Health Enterprises will use most of its  ₹9,275 crore IPO proceeds to cut debt, giving India's largest hospital chain by bed capacity room to raise capital for future acquisitions and expansion. The Temasek-backed company opens its IPO on 29 July with a price band of  ₹560-590 per share.

items.title: Lodha Developers' Q1 net profit doubles; pre-sales at  ₹4629 crore
items.summary: The developer is targeting  ₹24,000 crore of pre-sales from housing projects in the current financial year, compared to bookings of  ₹20,530 crore in FY26. Net debt of the company also reduced by  ₹446 crore to  ₹4,931 crore during the quarter.

items.title: AI is changing college admissions and placements: How to pick the right engineering degree for the AI era
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping Indian engineering education and career expectations.  Traditional college admission formulas are now being challenged by AI's rapid integration.  Employers seek graduates with AI skills and practical problem-solving abilities.  Colleges must update curricula and foster industry partnerships for future relevance.  Students need continuous learning and AI literacy for evolving job markets.

items.title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold rebounds above $4,070; silver at $59 as investors assess Middle East tensions
items.summary: The prices of precious metals gold and silver increased on 24 July, driven by the Middle Eastern conflict and anticipation of US rate hikes. Gold prices reached an intraday high of $4,073, while silver rose to $58.98, with both metals showing weekly gains amid global market uncertainty.

items.title: Cabinet clears Rs 1,264 crore Ballari-Guntakal rail line expansion, says MoS V Somanna
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved construction of new railway lines for Rs 1,264 crore. This project will add 46 km of railway lines across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. It will enhance passenger and freight movement, improving network capacity significantly. The project will improve connectivity for 99 villages, benefiting nearly seven lakh people. This investment supports the Centre's vision of Viksit Bharat by building world-class infrastructure.

items.title: Jindal Steel brings back former MD Sharma after CEO churn, revamps top leadership
items.summary: Besides Sharma's reappointment as MD, Jindal Steel announced appointments to the offices of chief financial officer, chief operating officer, and head of human resources, marking one of its biggest management overhauls in years

items.title: Generics maker Laurus Lab’s net profit more than doubles in Q1 on strong CDMO business growth
items.summary: Within CDMO, small molecules segment increased 69%, driven by growth in late-stage clinical and commercial API supplies.

items.title: CG Power Q1 profit rises 16% to ₹308 crore
items.summary: In the year-ago period, net profit stood at ₹266.87 crore, as per an exchange filing. Total income rose to ₹3,364.39 crore from ₹2,906.30 crore.

items.title: Strong metal prices help Hindustan Zinc kick off FY27 on a high note
items.summary: Hindustan Zinc also reported its lowest quarterly zinc cost of production, excluding royalty, since shifting to underground mining, helping further lift profitability.

Tata Consumer Products to pass higher input costs to buyers
items.summary: Tata Consumer Products plans to pass on rising input costs to consumers.  This strategy aims to protect the company's profit margins effectively.  The firm expects operating margins to expand by fifty to seventy basis points.  Recent price hikes and cost-saving initiatives will drive this margin growth.  The company reported strong revenue growth in its India and international businesses.

items.title: Prestige Group acquires 2.35-acre land in Mumbai's Mulund
items.summary: The transaction was executed through Prestige Mulund Realty Pvt Ltd, which acquired the property from Shamvik Glasstech Pvt Ltd and General Glass Company Pvt Ltd. The deal was registered on July 16, with the buyer paying stamp duty of Rs 6.64 crore, according to property registration documents accessed through CRE Matrix, realty data analytics platform.

items.title: CreditAccess Grameen Q1 net profit jumps 8-fold to Rs 493 cr
items.summary: CreditAccess Grameen reported an eight-fold increase in profits during the first quarter, driven by improved ground-level repayment rates and enhanced asset quality. The firm's pre-provision operating profit surged by thirty-four percent, while total income jumped twenty-two percent to achieve one thousand seven hundred eighty-four crore. Additionally, assets under management grew by sixteen point four percent, demonstrating a solid influx of new customers.

items.title: Despite price hikes, smartphone demand stays strong
items.summary: Most smartphone users will still buy devices despite ongoing price increases. Young users aged twenty-five to thirty are willing to pay more for their desired phones. Older users over fifty will stick to budgets or buy refurbished devices. Some consumers will delay purchases and keep using their current handsets. Brands offering balanced portfolios and affordability options will benefit.

items.title: American Express Q2 profit rises driven by higher spending and fewer delinquencies
items.summary: American Express has indicated an impressive eight percent growth in profit during the second quarter, largely driven by increased spending from card members and a decline in delinquency rates. The surge in sign-ups for the company's premium offerings showcases their effective customer acquisition strategies. However, it's worth noting that expenses saw a twelve percent rise due to marketing initiatives and product updates, marking a notable investment in future growth.

items.title: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman asks I-T officials to ease burden on honest taxpayers
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged tax officials to ensure taxpayer convenience. She stressed firm action against tax evasion and economic certainty. Officials must adopt an empathetic approach while enforcing tax laws. Sitharaman outlined five priorities for the Income Tax Department. She advised officials to exercise their powers with humility and agility.

items.title: ACC Q1 Results: Profit plunges 60% to Rs 147 crore on lower sales
items.summary: ACC Ltd, part of the Adani Group, reported a staggering 60.8% decline in net profit for the June quarter. This drop in profitability can be attributed to a decline in sales volume, resulting in a 7.75% decrease in revenue compared to the previous year. While higher costs impacted earnings, the company noted that premium products gained market share.

items.title: Lodha Developers' Q1 net profit doubles to record Rs 1,373 cr
items.summary: Lodha Developers reported a record profit and strong revenue growth for the quarter. The company successfully reduced its net debt while maintaining low leverage ratios. Pre-sales and collections saw significant year-on-year increases, reflecting robust market demand. Lodha plans substantial expansion in its annuity business over the next six years. The developer also sold land at its Palava Green Data Center Park.

items.title: REC Q1 Results: Net profit dips over 6% to Rs 4,193 crore
items.summary: REC Ltd reported a year-on-year profit decline of six percent for the June quarter, primarily due to lower interest income affecting its consolidated net profit. Additionally, total income dropped compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 4.25 per share and declared a final dividend of Rs 1.55 per share for the past fiscal year.

items.title: SAIL Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 138% YoY to  ₹1,636 crore; revenue remains flat
items.summary: SAIL reported a 138% YoY increase in net profit to  ₹1,636 crore for Q1 FY27, despite lower production. EBITDA rose 49% YoY to  ₹4,356 crore. The company moderated production due to geopolitical issues but aims for improved stability ahead.

items.title: Technology can't substitute professional judgement, audit quality responsibility lies with auditor: NFRA
items.summary: The National Financial Reporting Authority has introduced new principles for technology adoption by auditors. These guidelines promote the integration of sophisticated tools, emphasizing the importance of auditor accountability. While technology can enhance professional judgment, it is clarified that it should not be a substitute for it.

items.title: Lodha Developers Q1 Results: Profit jumps 2-fold to Rs 1,373 crore
items.summary: Lodha Developers reported a remarkable 100% increase in net profit for the first quarter, showcasing substantial growth in sales bookings, which rose by four percent to reach Rs 4,630 crore. Their total income has significantly outperformed the same quarter last year, marking the highest quarterly profit in the company's history. With confidence in sustaining a twenty percent CAGR, Lodha Developers is optimistic about long-term profit expansion.

items.title: Pulse of the Street: Oil spike knocks markets to sharpest weekly fall since mid-May
items.summary: Benchmark Nifty 50 and the Sensex fell 0.4% each on Friday to close at 23,767.45 and 76,059.75, respectively. For the week, the Nifty lost 2.3% while Sensex declined 2.6%, their steepest fall since the week ended 15 May, when the benchmarks had shed 2.7%.

items.title: Bank credit growth eases to 17.7% in fortnight to July 15
items.summary: Bank credit growth saw a slight deceleration to 17.7 percent year-on-year. Deposit growth also moderated to 12.7 percent in the same period. Outstanding bank credit reached Rs 217.3 lakh crore by mid-July. Deposits stood at Rs 262.9 lakh crore, maintaining a healthy ratio. Bankers noted steady credit demand, especially from the corporate sector.

items.title: V-Mart Retail Q1 Results: Profit surges 40% to Rs 47 crore
items.summary: V-Mart Retail has reported an impressive 40.5% increase in net profit for the June quarter, reaching Rs 47.21 crore, up from Rs 33.60 crore. Revenue from operations surged by 23% to Rs 1,088.81 crore, while total expenses grew by 22% to Rs 1,031.94 crore. The company has also broadened its horizons by launching 15 new store outlets, reflecting its expansive growth strategy.

items.title: Bank of India aims to raise $1.2 billion through FCNR-B deposits, plans additional $2 billion overseas borrowing
items.summary: Bank of India seeks $1.2 billion from foreign currency deposits and $2 billion from overseas borrowings.  The bank has already secured $200 million through the FCNR-B window.  This initiative aims to reduce reliance on costly bulk deposits for the institution.  First quarter net profit jumped 36% to Rs 3,068 crore, showing strong performance.  Advances grew 18.6% while deposits increased 14.9% during the period.

items.title: US stocks rise as oil retreats below $100, fresh tariffs and earnings in focus
items.summary: At 11:58 a.m. the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.70%, the S&amp;P 500 gained 0.59%, the Nasdaq Composite added 0.12%

items.title: Losing Wall Street binge premium! Why are Netflix shares in a freefall this year?
items.summary: Netflix shares have slumped despite higher revenue and profit as investors worry about slowing growth, weaker guidance and rich valuations. Wall Street is closely watching whether advertising, pricing power and engagement can sustain the streaming giant’s next phase of earnings growth.

items.title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq fall as investors juggle earnings, Mideast risks and tariffs
items.summary: Major stock indices experienced declines as concerns over artificial intelligence spending intensified. New tariffs and escalating Middle East conflict also weighed on investor sentiment. Chipmaker Intel's shares fell despite forecasting strong quarterly results and increased future spending. Geopolitical risks, including U.S. strikes in Iran, caused oil prices to surge significantly. Investors now await key economic data and Federal Reserve policy decisions next week.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q1 Results: Profit falls 72% to Rs 1,278 crore on one-off settlement hit
items.summary: Bank of Baroda's June-quarter profit fell 72% due to a Rs 5,680 crore one-off settlement, despite strong loan growth and stable asset quality. Excluding the exceptional item, profit rose, supported by higher net interest income and healthy retail lending.

items.title: Novo Nordisk pursues preliminary injunction to block Eli Lilly weight-loss drug ads
items.summary: Novo Nordisk is seeking a court injunction to stop Eli Lilly's drug advertisements. The Danish company claims Lilly's ads mislead consumers about treatment comparisons. Lilly denies wrongdoing and stands by its advertising claims. Both companies compete in the growing obesity and diabetes drug market. Novo Nordisk argues Lilly uses outdated studies in its campaigns.

items.title: Oil falls 3% to below $100/barrel but eyes weekly rise amid Trump's threats to Iran — Latest updates
items.summary: Oil futures fell over 3% due to disruptions in the Red Sea and heightened U.S.-Israeli-Iran tensions. Brent dropped to $97.10, but is on course for a 10% weekly gain, while WTI is set for an 8% increase amidst fears of further supply constraints.

items.title: Sebi clears IPOs of Intellius Recode, Nityas Gems & Jewellery
items.summary: Sebi approved the IPOs of Intellius Recode and Nityas Gems and Jewellery. Intellius plans to raise Rs 117 crore for AI-led digital worker development, while Nityas Gems will use fresh issue proceeds to fund working capital and business expansion.

India's SBI Card posts higher quarterly profit on asset quality boost
items.summary: SBI Cards announced an impressive profit surge attributed to lower provisions for bad loans. A remarkable rise in card spending highlighted robust consumer and corporate appetite, alongside a boost in total revenue propelled by increased transaction volumes across their card offerings. Furthermore, the company's asset quality has notably improved with a decline in gross non-performing assets and a significant yearly drop in loan loss provisions and credit costs.

items.title: Yen heads for biggest weekly drop since May despite Tokyo's support pledges
items.summary: The Japanese yen is experiencing a dramatic drop, marking its most significant weekly decline since May. The currency has hit 40-year lows against the US dollar, compounded by Japan's ineffective measures to bolster its value. Additionally, surging oil prices have reignited inflation worries, further enhancing the dollar's strength, while the euro and sterling have seen slight increases against it.

items.title: Amber Enterprises-owned IL JIN Electronics picks bankers for  ₹3,500 crore IPO
items.summary: IL JIN Electronics is expected to file its draft papers soon and is targeting a listing by the end of 2026-27.

items.summary: India and Israel remain committed to working towards the early conclusion of a balanced, comprehensive and mutually beneficial FTA which will further expand trade and economic ties

items.title: Welspun Corp Q1 Results: Profit nearly triples to Rs 1,048 crore
items.summary: It had reported a net profit of Rs 349.16 crore in the same period a year ago, the company said in an exchange filing.

items.title: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures edge higher as oil retreats; Intel jumps 4%
items.summary: US stock futures showed modest gains as crude oil prices fell. Dow futures rose 222 points, while concerns lingered from the Middle East conflict and tech investments. Investors are cautious ahead of upcoming earnings reports and central bank meetings.

items.title: Sebi bars former Axis MF dealer Viresh Joshi from securities markets for 7 years front-running case
items.summary: Sebi has banned Viresh Joshi and Prijesh Kurani from the securities market for seven years.  This action stems from a front-running case involving Axis Mutual Fund trades.  The regulator also ordered Rs 30.56 crore in impounded funds to be treated as disgorgement.  Joshi allegedly shared non-public fund information with Kurani for illicit trading.  The scheme involved multiple individuals and entities facilitating these wrongful gains.

items.title: India-US 'economic partnership continues' to grow despite pending trade deal: USISPF CEO Mukesh Aghi
items.summary: US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Mukesh Aghi on Friday said that the economic partnership between India and the United States continues to expand despite the absence of a bilateral trade agreement, with trade and investment flows growing steadily.

items.title: Sebi fines former Axis MF chief dealer, aides in  ₹30.56 crore front-running case
items.summary: The final order follows an investigation into trades between September 2021 and March 2022 after Sebi's surveillance system flagged suspicious trading patterns linked to Axis Mutual Fund's market transactions.

items.title: Quote of the day by John Rogers: "All of us, all of the time, have to be on guard against groupthink"
items.summary: Veteran investor John Rogers emphasizes the constant need to guard against groupthink.  This phenomenon occurs when individuals conform to group views instead of independent evaluation.   Encouraging diverse perspectives and challenging assumptions improves decision-making in various settings.

items.title: Digital Realty raises annual FFO forecast on robust data center demand
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust has raised its forecast for funds from operations for the entire year, driven by a surge in leasing activity from cloud computing and AI users.
